doc.name: waj-book
doc.instructions: WAJ Booking covers salons, spas, barbers, beauty clinics and other businesses on WAJ that take bookings through AI assistants: their services, prices, professionals and open times, and a link to book. search_businesses finds a business by name, service or area (nearest first when latitude and longitude are given); its `business` value identifies the business in the other tools. A booking goes find_available_times, then the customer's choice of time, then get_booking_link with that date and time. The link opens the business's booking site with those choices made; the customer enters their details and confirms there, and pays there if the business asks. Nothing is booked or held through this server, and no tool takes a name, phone number or payment details. Times are the business's local time; prices are in its currency.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.title: Find a business
tools.description: Salons, spas, barbers, clinics and other businesses on WAJ that take bookings through AI assistants, by name, service, category or area, nearest first when a location is given. Each result has a `business` value that identifies the business.

query.description: Words to match: the business's name, a service (e.g. 'gel nails', 'beard trim'), a category or an area or street. Every word has to match. Omit to list by distance only.
query.title: Query

latitude.description: Latitude of where the customer wants to go (their location or the centre of the area they named). Give with longitude to sort nearest first.
latitude.title: Latitude

radius_km.description: Only businesses with a branch within this many km of latitude/longitude.
radius_km.title: Radius Km

tools.name: get_business_info
tools.title: Business info
tools.description: The business's name, description, contact phone, currency, booking website, and its branches with address, phone, opening hours, time zone and a booking link for each.

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: Services and prices
tools.description: Services and packages that can be booked online, grouped by category, with duration in minutes and price in the business currency (options, offers and lowest price where they apply). Filter by branch, category or text.

branch.description: Branch id or name. Omit to list the services of every branch.
branch.title: Branch

query.description: Text to match against service, category and package names and descriptions.
query.title: Query

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business

tools.name: list_staff
tools.title: Professionals
tools.description: Professionals customers can choose when booking online, optionally only those who perform a given service (with their price for it, in the business currency) or work at a given branch.

branch.description: Branch id or name. Omit for every branch.
branch.title: Branch

service.description: Service id or name; returns only professionals who perform it, with their price for it.
service.title: Service

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business

tools.name: find_available_times
tools.title: Available times
tools.description: Open start times for a service or package at a branch, for one day or up to 7 consecutive days, with any professional or a chosen one. Times are local to the branch. These are the times the business's booking website offers; they are not held.

service.description: Service id or name. Give this or package.
service.title: Service

option.description: Option id or name, required when the service has options.
option.title: Option

package.description: Package id or name, instead of service.
package.title: Package

branch.description: Branch id or name. Required when the business has more than one branch.
branch.title: Branch

staff.description: Professional's name. Omit for any professional.
staff.title: Staff

date.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD, in the branch's local calendar. Defaults to today.
date.title: Date

end_date.description: Last day to search (inclusive), at most 6 days after date. Defaults to date.
end_date.title: End Date

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.title: Booking link
tools.description: A link to the business's booking website with the branch, service or package, professional and, optionally, an open start time pre-selected (the time is re-checked first). The booking, the customer's details and any payment are completed on the website.

service.description: Service id or name to pre-select. Give this or package, or neither for the plain booking page.
service.title: Service

option.description: Option id or name of the service, used to check the time when the service has options. The customer still picks the option on the site.
option.title: Option

package.description: Package id or name to pre-select instead of a service.
package.title: Package

branch.description: Branch id or name to pre-select.
branch.title: Branch

date.description: Day of the chosen start time, YYYY-MM-DD, branch local. Give with time.
date.title: Date

time.description: Chosen start time, HH:MM (24h), branch local, one of the business's open start times. Give with date; needs a service or package.
time.title: Time

language.description: Site language code: en, ar, tr, ru or de. Defaults to the business's default language.
language.title: Language

business.description: The business's `business` value, as given in search results.
business.title: Business
